projects.name: Asir Leaf
projects.description: Collected and labelled 6,400 coffee-plant leaf photos with two farmers' cooperatives and an agronomist; cleaned data by removing blurred shots and balanced rare disease classes via augmentation (rotating, flipping, cropping); used transfer learning in PyTorch by retraining the last layers of a pretrained network; evaluated on a held-out farm's photos never seen during training, reporting per-disease precision and recall with a confusion matrix; tuned 24 combinations of learning rate, batch size and frozen layers based on validation performance; compressed the model for under one-second inference on a mid-range offline Android phone; deployed it in an app used by eleven farmers for a month; achieved 93% correct classification across five disease classes.

projects.name: Used-car prices
projects.description: Predicted asking prices from 18,000 Saudi classified adverts by comparing linear regression, random forest, and gradient boosting models; the boosted model achieved an average error of 9%.
